title: The 10-Year Delay That Costs $400,130
description:
This video breaks down the exact cost of waiting ten years to start investing. By comparing a 25-year-old and a 35-year-old both saving $200 a month at an 8% return, we show how a simple delay costs over $400,000 in compound interest.

Free 7-day Money Reset checklist + calculators: https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/money-reset/

Educational content, not financial advice. Narration and visuals are AI-assisted.
